appearance.sprite_progression_gate: 51A4F0 pauses subsequent sprite advancement while appearance or death effect mode is nonzero.

mode1.limit: Elapsed is the caller-provided source progression counter, not milliseconds.

initialization.opacity_source: Scanner uses optional per_frame_mask byte when DGP header[5] is nonzero; otherwise passes -1 and callback sets target255.
initialization.initial_progress: For nonzero target current=-scaledY; zero target current0. After scan, add minScaledX over all scanned main pixels to every current.
initialization.rng_limit: No rand/native RNG call occurs in this scanner/callback or mode5 loop. Other effect modes are not covered by this statement.

progression.otherwise: current = target; this record contributes no active flag
progression.completion: Return0 when every record satisfies pre-update current+8 >= target; empty record list returns0.

mode5.one_to_one_formula: For these source roles (no opacity plane), nonempty main image: max(1, ceil((255 + maxOpaquePixelY - minOpaquePixelX) / 8)) renderer calls after the LAST elapsed0 initialization. Empty main image completes on its first call.
limits: There is no fixed elapsed completion threshold for mode5.
If elapsed0 is supplied repeatedly, initialization repeats and resets particle coefficients.
Source scaling requires scanner550270 local coordinates, not an assumed atlas/image height or ordinary resized bounding box.
Native wall-clock cadence/render invocation count is separate from the per-invocation arithmetic; 60 source clock value is not a total lifetime.
The formula proves completion for a chosen source frame/scale; it does not reproduce RGB565 interpolation or original projected screen coordinates.

appearance.renderer_clear_rule: Source stage renderer clears appearance mode, immune gate and source action clock only when552642 returns0.

dispatcher.source_death_rng: rand modulo7 plus1 chooses one of mode1..7. This field is not an opacity decrement or speed increment.

policy.selection: Core performs sourceLookup in native roster order and consumes native RNG; view receives the selected chr_skill_index.
policy.appearance: All connected id11 command7 records use byte+0x47=5. Its source pixel progression does not add an RNG draw. Preserve record order and pause sprites while the renderer effect is active.

policy.corpse: Source id12 final pose is available. Player corpse hold until revive is the requested presentation behavior, separate from enemy fade.
